description: Event synchronisation of pair.es after Quiroga, Kreuz and Grassberger, as python-package/opentsx/algorithms/event_sync.py computes it: events are local maxima above mean + sigma * std (population std), q_total = Q, q_ab = c(B|A) / sqrt(mA mB) (A leads), q_ba = c(A|B) / sqrt(mA mB), q_rand = mean Q of A against 10 copies of B with shuffled inter-event intervals, drawn by Mulberry32(1). Times are tick indices. Generated by tools/pair_es_vectors.py; run by python-package/tests/test_event_sync.py and opentsx-saas-frontend (es.test.ts).
